gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans opens its round letters wide, lowercase filling most of the height. Shrink Nordic and its pinched, closed letters clog up, whereas Noto Sans stays open at any size.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Curve endings held well apart and tall, full lowercase c, s and z give Noto Sans Adlam its sans-serif openness. Nordic stays the weighty voice; the body text reads smoothly beneath it.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Nordic's letters pinch shut like folded leaves, drawn in one monoweight stroke with a powerful, ancient air. But Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits beside it modern and spacious, its curve ends well away from the stem.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian is sans-serif with lowercase standing tall and full, round letters wide and inviting. Noto Sans Armenian keeps text approachable under Nordic, whose bent-paperclip strokes never swell or thin.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Nordic is powerful and ancient, with horizontals no thinner than its verticals and letters pinched closed. Noto Sans Avestan, plain sans with a pronounced x-height, keeps long reading comfortable.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Powerful and ancient, Nordic pinches its letters shut, while Noto Sans Buginese leaves its mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs. Nordic earns its keep when it is big and the words are short.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Pinched and powerful, Nordic makes its horizontals weigh exactly what its verticals do. And Noto Sans Buhid, sans-serif with a high-set x-height and generous curve gaps, lets text run on easily.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-carian: In Noto Sans Carian, terminals stay apart like open scissor blades and ascender tops sit nearly level with the x-height line. The wire-bent, closed Nordic makes that openness the standout.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-cham: Ancient and weighty, Nordic is all closed, monoweight letters spaced like far-apart brush dabs. Yet Noto Sans Cham, plain sans with tall rounded lowercase and generous entry space, keeps text flowing cleanly.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads defines Noto Sans Cuneiform. Its e opens up rather than shutting, setting it against Nordic's closed, pressed-leaf letters whose bowls match their stems.
